read.thesis: Organic sales +3% on volume +2% and price +1%, with core gross margin down 100bp and FY26 EPS now guided to the low end as P&G steps up reinvestment; supply discipline signals are absent.

triggers.label: Core EPS guidance skewed to low end
triggers.quote: P&G now expects fiscal 2026 EPS results to be toward the lower-end of the guidance range.

triggers.label: Organic volume +2%, price +1%
triggers.quote: Organic sales increased three percent driven by a two percent increase from volume and a one percent increase from higher pricing.

triggers.label: Core gross margin down 100bp on reinvestment
triggers.quote: The decrease was driven by 180 basis points of unfavorable mix, 100 basis points of reinvestments

guidance.quote: P&G maintained its guidance range for fiscal 2026 all-in sales growth to be in the range of one to five percent
The Company also maintained its outlook for organic sales growth in the range of in-line to up four percent versus the prior year.
P&G also maintained its fiscal 2026 core earnings per share growth to be in the range of in-line to up four percent
P&G now expects fiscal 2026 EPS results to be toward the lower-end of the guidance range.
Capital spending is estimated to be in the range of four to five percent of fiscal 2026 net sales.
P&G continues to expect adjusted free cash flow productivity of 85% to 90%

red_flags.label: Reinvestment squeezing margins, EPS to low end
red_flags.quote: The Company also noted it is increasing investments in innovation and demand creation to maintain positive momentum with consumers.
